body.objective: Turn the landed Conflux rediscovery and exploratory-candidate machinery into consumer-gated discovery paths for the resident Pure-Weyl teams. The immediate consumers, in order, are sf:program/work/nonlinear-conflux-branch-mixing-discovery, sf:program/work/classical-conflux-relative-lift-discovery, and sf:program/work/bridge-conflux-atlas-generalization. Deferred consumers are the observer common-action diagnosis and quantum LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC discovery tickets. Reuse the production Conflux engine, discovery receipt, conjecture lifecycle, Certlab composition, and family sweep; do not build parallel demonstration tools. If a requested pilot already works, answer with the exact production command, accepted schemas, rule-set identities, gate, and resource boundary rather than adding code.
body.stop_condition: Land a documented resident-physics discovery adapter and consumer preflight with the following properties. (1) From this physics repository, one production command can declare a consumer, exact input schemas and hashes, certified rediscovery rule sets, optional exploratory rule sets, and an explicit resource budget. (2) A preflight reports SUPPORTED or a typed missing capability before saturation. (3) The nonlinear pilot imports the certified q2/q3/ell2/ell3 and branch metadata needed to search for branch-selection and cyclic-redefinition invariants. (4) The classical pilot imports the complete five-current second jet and invariant order-one relative-lift equations and can search for a lift or minimal inconsistent subsystem with direct-substitution witnesses. (5) The bridge pilot imports exact divisor, pairing, group-action and atlas payloads across at least three carriers and can search for a common invariant normal form without reading claim verdicts as data. (6) Every candidate remains separate from certified rediscoveries, records the equivalence-ladder level and searched budget, exports a conjecture draft, and has an independent replay or an explicit unsupported boundary. (7) At least two decisive negative controls exist per pilot family and two clean runs are byte-identical. (8) Missing rule kinds or import shapes can be returned as stable typed requests/deliveries to the originating physics work item without editing physics certificates or planning views. (9) The observer pilot remains disabled until its common-action payload passes a consumer-specific gate, the quantum pilot is restricted to LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC inputs, and black-hole/Hadamard inputs are refused by capability policy. (10) Documentation names exact commands, versions, hashes, resource ceilings, lifecycle effects, and honest non-establishments.
body.forbid: hard-coding a desired branch table, chain lift, divisor theorem, or expected coefficient into the engine or rule sets; importing physics claim verdicts, prose summaries, exact_checks, or certificate flags as discovery facts; treating embeddings, numerical coincidence, heuristic cost, or an AI interpretation as mathematical equivalence; promoting CANDIDATE, REDISCOVERED_KNOWN, or a Forge-side replay directly into a physics claim; auto-editing physics certificates, papers, atlases, work items, locks, or baselines; silently rounding approximate data to exact; running unbounded saturation or hiding budget exhaustion; duplicating the production Conflux engine in a private pilot; requiring Conflux for resident work whose consumer gate is absent; applying this request to Schwarzschild/black-hole operators, Hadamard wavefront analysis, positivity, particles, scattering, or unitarity; weakening the independent-verification rule; making resident physics teams patch the Tango repository instead of answering through this committed request channel.
notes: Priority is nonlinear first, classical second, bridge third. Observer follows only after sf:program/work/observer-common-action-ward-orbit closes with a repaired payload. Quantum is local algebra only. Black-hole is deliberately excluded.

Canonical documentation: forge/tools/science-forge/conflux/README.md, DISCOVERY-SWEEP.md, PROVENANCE.md, forge/docs/structure-finding-thesis.md, and the physics planning/forge-requests/README.md protocol.
